purpose: The things that go wrong, or get awkward, on a SaaS product showcase that neither the visitor nor the owner will think to specify. One check per edge is expected in e2e/.

status.handled: Defined behaviour, clear to the visitor and the owner.
status.partial: Copes, but someone may be left unaware.
status.open: Needs an owner decision or a feature this version excludes.

tested.yes: An automated check in e2e/ proves it.

edges.edge: The brief has no main button link.
edges.visitor_sees: A button that scrolls to the pricing section.
edges.owner_sees: 'Set your link' in the review list.
edges.default_behavior: Scroll to the pricing section, or the closing section when pricing is off; never href='#' or an empty href.

edges.edge: The link is a mailto or a very long URL.
edges.visitor_sees: A normal button that opens it.
edges.default_behavior: Accept mailto and https URLs; reject anything else and treat it as no link.

edges.edge: A navigation or footer link has no target.
edges.visitor_sees: A link that goes to the top of the page.
edges.owner_sees: Listed under placeholders as 'Set your link'.
edges.default_behavior: Point to the top of the page; never an empty href.

edges.edge: A footer column has no links.
edges.visitor_sees: The column is not shown.
edges.default_behavior: Hide an empty column; keep Privacy, Terms and Security visible as 'Set your link' links.

edges.edge: The owner switched off pricing and testimonials.
edges.visitor_sees: A page with no such sections and no links to them.
edges.default_behavior: Leave the sections out entirely, including nav and footer links.

edges.edge: Pricing is on but the owner gave no plans.
edges.visitor_sees: Two sample plans, Starter and Growth, with a 'Sample' label.
edges.owner_sees: 'Set your price' in the review list.
edges.default_behavior: Show the sample plans, flagged, and list under placeholders.

edges.edge: One plan, or plans with very different feature counts.
edges.visitor_sees: One centred narrow card, or equal-height cards.
edges.default_behavior: Centre a single card; align buttons at the bottom of equal-height cards.

edges.edge: The yearly price does not divide evenly.
edges.visitor_sees: Whole-dollar amounts, rounded down.
edges.default_behavior: yearly = floor(monthly x 12 x (1 - discount)); per-month = floor(yearly / 12). Never show cents for calculated amounts.

edges.edge: The owner typed a price like $19.99.
edges.visitor_sees: Exactly $19.99.
edges.default_behavior: Owner-typed prices are never rounded or reformatted; only calculated amounts are whole dollars.

edges.edge: The same price appears in cards, FAQ and a comparison table.
edges.visitor_sees: The same figure everywhere.
edges.default_behavior: Read from the plan data; never typed a second time.

edges.edge: The owner asks for more than three plans.
edges.visitor_sees: Three plans.
edges.owner_sees: A note that the extra plans were left out.
edges.default_behavior: Keep the first three and log it in AGENT_LOG.md.

edges.edge: The brief has one testimonial, a very long one, or none.
edges.visitor_sees: One wide centred card, a clipped long quote, or a labelled sample.
edges.default_behavior: Never invent a person; the sample uses 'Example Name' and a 'Sample' label.

edges.edge: More than three steps or six benefits are listed.
edges.visitor_sees: The first three steps, the first six benefits.
edges.default_behavior: Ignore the extras and note it in AGENT_LOG.md.

edges.edge: The headline is very long.
edges.visitor_sees: At most three lines at 375 wide.
edges.default_behavior: Clamp the font size; never overflow.

edges.edge: The hero image is missing, huge or fails to load.
edges.visitor_sees: A plain labelled placeholder box; the page does not jump.
edges.default_behavior: Always render the placeholder; use an image only when the content file points at one that loads.

edges.edge: A gallery or use-case card needs an image the owner has not given.
edges.visitor_sees: A plain labelled box.
edges.default_behavior: Use a labelled placeholder; never fetch or generate pictures.

edges.edge: The brief gives no claim for something that sounds like one (security, compliance, customer numbers).
edges.visitor_sees: No such wording on the page.
edges.default_behavior: Leave it out; never write certification, compliance or security claims.

edges.edge: The owner asks for legal text.
edges.visitor_sees: Links only.
edges.owner_sees: A note that legal text is not written here.
edges.default_behavior: Do not write privacy, terms or security wording; link to the owner's pages.

edges.edge: The FAQ mentions a price and the price later changes.
edges.visitor_sees: The same figure as the pricing section.
edges.default_behavior: Change the plan data and re-derive; check the FAQ in the change.

edges.edge: FAQ is used with the keyboard.
edges.visitor_sees: Items open and close with Enter and Space, with a visible focus ring.
edges.default_behavior: Use accessible accordion buttons.

edges.edge: The visitor switches between Monthly and Yearly.
edges.visitor_sees: Prices change in the section; nothing else moves.
edges.default_behavior: Monthly is the default view; the switch is keyboard operable.

edges.edge: A crawler asks for robots.txt or the sitemap.
edges.visitor_sees: A valid robots.txt and a sitemap with the home page.
edges.default_behavior: Provide both.

edges.edge: The site is built with no environment variables.
edges.visitor_sees: The page loads.
edges.default_behavior: This pack needs none; a missing variable must never stop the build.

edges.edge: The owner picks the dark colour with a calm tone.
edges.visitor_sees: A dark page with readable text.
edges.default_behavior: Use deep-tech with the calm wording; contrast stays at least 4.5:1.

edges.edge: The owner gave their own brand words.
edges.visitor_sees: Wording and look follow them.
edges.default_behavior: Prefer the owner's words over the preset's defaults and note it in AGENT_LOG.md.

edges.edge: A secondary button has no link yet (for example Watch demo).
edges.visitor_sees: A quieter button that scrolls to How it works.
edges.owner_sees: 'Set your link' in the review list.
edges.default_behavior: Allow it, scroll to How it works and flag it; never leave a button that does nothing.
